messages.ec42eb3a0cb76d54: Faka iphasiwedi yefayela lokudlulisa endaweni ehlukene
messages.ecee1e18a8dea481: Qedela ukutholwa kwesitoreji esivikelekile? Ikhophi ebetheliwe ekhona kanye nedatha yoqobo ngeke isuswe.
messages.ee5ebc1ac9c8af20: Ukusetha kabusha kuzosusa unomphela ingobo yomlando yemithi ekhanseliwe, shintsha umlando, nefayela lokungena. Qhubeka?
messages.eef0abe9f43d061f: Ikhophi ebethelwe engaphelele ayitholakali. Akukho okushintshile.
messages.f3fe9942107a89af: Amafayela angaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi aselungisiwe futhi aqinisekiswa.
messages.f698bc440cabcde7: Isibonelo: 500 mg / 1 tablet / Vitamin D 2000 IU
messages.f700bad1fa9bf26c: Faka iphasiwedi yefayela lokudlulisa endaweni ehlukile (okungenani izinhlamvu eziyi-12)
messages.fc064c0ab095fa4b: Ayikho ilogu yomcimbi elondoloziwe yaleli rekhodi elidala lengobo yomlando. Idatha engenhla irekhodi lesifundo sokwelashwa esilondoloziwe, hhayi umlando owenziwe kabusha.
messages.fd5474467c6d4477: Uhlelo lukhanseliwe ukuze lulungiswe ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
messages.ffdc6cc67a30cb67: Nsuku zonke - ukuthathwa kwemithi okuhleliwe kukhiqizwa nsuku zonke ngesikhathi esishiwo.
